en.headline: Ocean Park Tower halts mid-air, stranding about 40 visitors
en.dek: A mechanical fault stopped the observation cabin at about 3.30pm on Monday; one visitor felt unwell and was brought down by firefighters, with no injuries reported.
body: The Ocean Park Tower at the Southern district theme park suffered a suspected mechanical fault at about 3.30pm on Monday, leaving its observation cabin halted partway up the structure and stranding about 40 visitors.

Most of those on board returned to the ground under the guidance of park staff. One visitor who reported feeling unwell was later assisted down by firefighters using a rope descent, and no injuries were reported.

The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said amusement rides that experience incidents must submit a report under the law. Director Pang Kwok-ying said the department would investigate the cause and that the park would draw up measures to prevent a recurrence.
The same tower experienced a fault in May last year that left 17 visitors stranded for nearly two hours; the park said at the time that a safety system had activated.

zh.headline: 海洋公園摩天塔機件故障 約40人一度被困半空
zh.dek: 星期一約下午3時半觀光塔停於半空，一名遊客感到不適由消防人員游繩帶離，暫未有人受傷。
body: 海洋公園的海洋摩天塔星期一（9日）下午約3時半懷疑出現機件故障，觀光塔停在半空，約40名遊客一度被困。
大部分遊客在園方職員帶領下返回地面。一名報稱感到不適的遊客其後由消防人員以游繩方式協助離開，事件中暫未有人受傷。
機電工程署署長潘國英表示，涉及機動遊戲的事故，園區須按法例向署方提交報告。署方會派員調查成因，園方亦會訂立方案防止同類事件再次發生。
資料顯示，海洋摩天塔去年5月亦曾發生故障，當時有17名乘客被困近兩小時，園方當時稱是安全系統啟動所致。
